scope: Silk lapis Cabochon icon adoption on the v7 icon branch, including the toolbar-mark derivation; no release or installed-app replacement.

design_provenance.notes: Canonical SVG adds only the tile-edge/tile-face/cabochon ids required by write_phone_icon plus a cabochon wrapper group; 256px renders are sha256-identical to the Downloads export. Regenerating the mark outputs leaves every other output hash unchanged (determinism recheck 2026-09-28).

source_identity.method: rsvg-convert 256px renders of Downloads/lapis-silk.svg and assets/lapis.svg compared by sha256

mark_png.derivation: write_mark_icon: defs + cabochon group over a viewBox sized to the stone ellipse bounds plus 12% margin; 512px inspection render has the stone centered (0.500/0.500), transparent corners, white star at center

checks.bundle_icon_reference: lapis (Info.plist.in ${MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE}; CMake installs macos/lapis.icns into Resources; filename unchanged)
visual_review: 1024 site icon: tile, bevel, dome, six slim white rays reaching the stone edge along each ray direction, silk sheen band, no clipping or banding
iOS 1024 asset: flat #1C2234 background edge to edge, no tile edge remnants, stone/star/sheen present and centered
32px decode (upscaled): tile/stone/glow hierarchy legible; ray count and sheen degrade gracefully
16px decode (upscaled): dark rounded tile, blue stone, bright star center remain readable
checks.verification_method: independent vision-model inspection of rendered outputs
